propositions: Recovery operation must be invoked exactly once at the write-bearing reconcile boundary, after under-lock staleness validation and before the first remote issue fetch.
All read-only and filtered reconciliation paths must perform zero writes from the recovery operation.
A durable tombstone must remain authoritative and not be revoked by automatic 200, clear_absent, or same-key confirmation.
Completion failure must preserve the overlap for retry and perform zero remote calls, because the call precedes any remote observation.
The invocation site is reconcile.py after staleness gate and scoped_ids computation, not run_differs.py; only four lines added to spine respecting 800-line cap.
Refusal of recovery on read-only or scoped passes must be free with no classification or repository reads.
